start: Member of a gym with its own colour, Wear OS watch with the MettleUp watch app

steps.action: Start a workout on the phone
user_sees: The watch app opens drawn in the gym's colour (lightened if too dark for the black screen)
must_not: MettleUp orange for a gym with a colour
A colour too dark to read on the watch

start: Gym with only a background tone and no colour of its own

must_not: The background tone used as the watch colour
A blank or broken colour on the watch

start: Member leaves the gym between two workouts

user_sees: The watch back in MettleUp orange
must_not: The old gym's colour kept on the watch
The colour changing in the middle of a workout
